P.text: A gauge is killed via killGauge() and later revived via reviveGauge(); neither function updates the gauge-specific supplyIndex[_gauge] checkpoint, so it remains frozen at the pre-kill value while the global index accumulator continues to grow with each notifyRewardAmount.
P.evidence_quote: Neither `killGauge()` nor `reviveGauge()` updates the per-gauge checkpoint that tracks reward distribution eligibility

I.text: A killed gauge's supplyIndex should be synchronized/reset to the current global index so that reward accrual during its inactive period is excluded.
I.evidence_quote: Without resetting `supplyIndex` to the current `index`, a revived gauge inherits the stale checkpoint from before it was killed, making it eligible to claim rewards it never earned.

V.text: Upon revival, _updateForAfterDistribution() computes rewards from the delta between the current index and the stale supplyIndex, allowing the revived gauge to retroactively claim rewards that accrued during its inactive period.
V.evidence_quote: Upon revival, this stale checkpoint allows the gauge to retroactively claim all rewards that accrued during its inactive period through the [_updateForAfterDistribution()] calculation.
